title: Seedance 2.5 Flash Guide: Speed, Price and Prompts
summary: Seedance 2.5 Flash guide: what ByteDance's faster video model costs in Flick, how fast it rendered in our tests, and three real prompts with their results.
body_markdown:
### What is Seedance 2.5 Flash?


Seedance 2.5 Flash is ByteDance's faster, cheaper version of its Seedance 2.5 video model. In Flick it animates a start frame or builds a shot from up to 10 reference images, with sound, at 480p or 720p.


### How much does Seedance 2.5 Flash cost?


In Flick, a 5 second Seedance 2.5 Flash shot costs 160 credits at 720p and 70 at 480p. The longest shot, 30 seconds at 720p, costs 960.


### How fast is Seedance 2.5 Flash?


Our Seedance 2.5 Flash shots of 5 seconds took 94 to 101 seconds each in Flick, Flick's queue included, against 152 to 295 seconds for the same shots on Seedance 2.5.


### How long can a Seedance 2.5 Flash video be?


A Seedance 2.5 Flash shot in Flick runs 4 to 30 seconds, in any whole second, made in one pass with its sound.


### Can I use Seedance 2.5 Flash for free?


Seedance 2.5 Flash in Flick needs the Standard plan or higher, from $20 a month. Flick gives 100 credits when you sign up, which you can spend on the image models that make start frames.


### Is Seedance 2.5 Flash better than Seedance 2.5?


Seedance 2.5 Flash is faster and a third cheaper, and in our tests it matched Seedance 2.5 on a spoken line, a latte pour and a crane move. Seedance 2.5 renders 1080p and takes up to 30 reference images.
